q: The Benamou-Brenier formula gives a dynamic (fluid mechanics) characterization of W₂²(μ₀,μ₁) as:
opts: The minimal total variation of the path
inf ∫₀¹ ∫|v(t,x)|² dμ_t(x) dt over paths (μ_t, v_t) satisfying the continuity equation ∂_t μ + ∇·(vμ) = 0
The geodesic length in KL geometry
The Fisher information along the path
exp: Benamou-Brenier: W₂²(μ₀,μ₁) = min ∫₀¹ ∫|v|² dμ_t dt subject to the continuity equation. This formulation links optimal transport to fluid mechanics and is the basis for numerical computation of Wasserstein distances.
